auditor_sam: Morning We need an evidence drop for SOC2/ISO review: RBAC rollouts in the last 90 days, one end-to-end trace (PR -> CI -> kube audit -> KMS), service-account removals, and vuln tickets that led to changes. ETA?

tara_sec: We can produce a compact bundle: rolebinding_changes.csv, traced_example/, kms_events.csv, service_account_deprov.csv, control_mapping.md, README.txt. Aim for 18:00 UTC.

phil_oncall: I'll generate the CSV of deltas with columns: pr_id, author, approver, cluster, binding, added, removed, jira. Will tag entries with "vuln" if tied to a ticket. ETA 16:30 UTC.

alex_infra: For kube-apiserver audit I'm running this Splunk query to extract relevant events:

```splunk
index=k8s_audit ("RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding") | where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-90d@d") | table _time user verb objectRef.name objectRef.namespace annotations.pr_id requestID
```

alex_infra: For AWS KMS I'll run Athena over CloudTrail parquet: eventName IN ('Encrypt','Decrypt','GenerateDataKey') and filter by principal or keyId from our mapping.

auditor_sam: Make sure timestamps are ISO8601 with timezone and include PR URL + screenshot for the traced example. Also include proof of token invalidation for deprovs or last_active logs.

tara_sec: Noted. Phil, can you flag any SA deprovs and include lastAuth timestamp + deletion event IDs?

phil_oncall: Yes. Example row will have sa_email, last_active_iso, deprov_event_id, iam_change_log_url. If rotated, we'll note rotation_ticket instead of deprov_event_id.

phil_oncall: One RBAC tighten was from JIRA SEC-4710 (privilege audit). I'll mark those rows and include the ticket summary.

alex_infra: Uploading preliminary bundle: https://evidence.redwood.example/signed/zz99yy88 (valid 36h). Contains rolebinding_changes.csv, traced_example/{pr_screenshot.png, pipeline_log.txt, kube_audit_snippet.txt, kms_event_row.csv}, service_account_deprov.csv, control_mapping.md, README.txt.

evidence-bot: artifact-uploaded evidence-bucket/engsec/3725019999_bundle.zip (size=2.6MB) :package:

auditor_sam: Received. I'll spot-check the traced example and timestamps. If I need more, i'll follow up in this thread. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
